extracted.intended_audience: BBC journalists, editors, producers, contributors and other staff responsible for creating or publishing BBC content
extracted.subtask_description: A comprehensive set of editorial values, standards and mandatory referral points that govern how BBC content is produced, published and reused across all platforms worldwide. Covers impartiality, accuracy, privacy, legal considerations and other topic-specific guidance for newsroom and content teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: The BBC's Editorial Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction; The BBC's Editorial Values; How to use the Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out the BBC's editorial values and standards and explains how staff should apply the Guidelines. The Editorial Guidelines apply to all BBC content wherever in the world it is broadcast or published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers requirements and principles for impartial coverage, and identifies situations that require mandatory referral to editors/management for advice or escalation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets standards for factual correctness, verification and correction processes; includes mandatory referral points for significant or uncertain accuracy issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines how to identify and manage personal, financial or other conflicts that could affect editorial judgement, and when such conflicts must be referred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Harm and Offence
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on avoiding unnecessary harm or offence in content, including principles for judgement and situations requiring referral to senior staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets expectations for treating people and viewpoints fairly in coverage, and procedural steps where fairness concerns arise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for respecting individuals' privacy in reporting and production, with mandatory referral points for complex or potentially intrusive cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crime and Anti-social Behaviour
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for reporting crime and anti-social behaviour, balancing public interest with legal and ethical considerations; includes referral triggers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Children and Young People as Contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific protections and procedural requirements when children or young people contribute to BBC content, including consent and safeguarding referral points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Politics and Public Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements for covering political subjects and public policy, including impartiality obligations and referral procedures for sensitive political matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistics, Polls, Data and Surveys
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for use and presentation of statistical information, polls and survey data to ensure accuracy, context and transparency; includes mandatory referrals for contested or significant data issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: War, Terror and Extreme Violence, Disaster and Disorder
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for reporting on extreme events that may cause distress, including editorial safeguards, contextualisation and referral points for high-risk or graphic content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of BBC Content after Publication or Broadcast
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and principles governing re-use, sharing and licensing of BBC content after initial publication or broadcast, and when to refer re-use questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religious Content
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for covering religious topics and communities with sensitivity and accuracy, including principles and practical editorial guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence from Commercial and other External Interests
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria to safeguard editorial independence from commercial, political or other external pressures, and mandatory referral points where independence may be compromised.

rubrics_metrics.name: External Relationships, including Commercial Relationships, and Financing
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on managing relationships with external partners, sponsors or funders and how financing arrangements must be handled to protect editorial integrity; includes referral requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competitions, Votes and Interactivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Principles; Mandatory Referrals; Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial standards and procedural requirements governing competitions, audience voting, interactive formats and user-generated content, with referral points for problematic cases.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Law
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and Mandatory Referrals; General; Principal Legal Considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overview of legal obligations and principal legal considerations affecting BBC content (defamation, contempt, privacy, etc.), and circumstances that require mandatory legal referral.
